name: Constant Contact
description: Constant Contact is a digital and email marketing platform that helps small businesses build email and SMS campaigns, landing pages, and automations from a single tool, with integrations that keep contacts and order data in sync.
best_for: Positioned for small businesses that want an easy-to-use platform for email and SMS marketing, sign-up forms, and landing pages without needing a dedicated marketing team.
features: Automated email sends for events like welcomes, birthdays, and re-sends to non-openers
SMS marketing with automated VIP alerts, abandoned-cart reminders, and event updates
Custom automation paths with branching and triggered actions
Website sign-up forms, pop-ups, and lead-generation landing pages
Integrations with popular CRMs and e-commerce platforms to sync contacts and orders

alternatives.name: Mailchimp
alternatives.description: An email and SMS marketing platform combining analytics, automations, and AI tools for integrated customer communications.
alternatives.best_for: Small to mid-sized businesses wanting AI content generation and a wide app ecosystem

alternatives.name: Brevo
alternatives.description: An integrated marketing and CRM platform for email, SMS, WhatsApp, and chat campaigns.

alternatives.name: GetResponse
alternatives.description: An all-in-one marketing platform combining email, automation, landing pages, and webinars.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses that also need webinars and AI-assisted landing pages
